_source: Google reviews of Kay Diving, transcribed by hand from the listing. Quoted as written — spelling, punctuation and all. Two were cut at a sentence boundary where Google itself truncated them with 'More'; nothing was reworded. Emoji were dropped from one.
_markup: These are NOT marked up as Review/AggregateRating, and must not be. Google's own policy is that reviews gathered on a third-party site are not eligible for review rich results on yours, and self-serving markup of them is a manual-action risk. Showing them is fine; claiming them as first-party structured data is not.
_dates: Google only gives a relative age ('a year ago'), so these are years, not months: no false precision.
_score: The listing's own figures, read off it by hand on 28 October 2026. They do not update themselves: when the count moves, this moves when someone moves it. Shown as text only — never as AggregateRating, for the reason in _markup.

items.name: Gordon Kirkwood
items.text: Excellent diving in Cenotes of Tulum. Federico is a very good guide, and he went out of his way to make sure I had a good diving experience. I prefer diving in the more open Cenotes of Tulum and he was good with taking me to those, despite him being fully cave qualified.

items.name: Richard Daley
items.text: Had an awesome experience diving with Frederico in Tulum cenotes. He's very professional, communicates clearly and reads your dive style quickly; personalising the dive experience to suit your needs.

items.name: Emma Davies
items.text: I had a beautiful day diving cenotes with Federico. He was a great guide and I felt very safe. It was a special experience to see the cenotes from under the water — a peaceful side of Tulum that I'm glad I explored.

items.name: Regs Cabrera
items.text: Excelente clase, todos éramos principiantes y todo fue super adecuado y bien explicado. Gozamos de la experiencia como no tienen idea! Super instructor Fede! 100% vale la pena y sin duda lo volveremos a hacer.

items.name: Karl Kerkhofs
items.text: We family of 4 divers enjoyed our 2 cenotes dives a lot, when we visited Tulum in July 2024. Federico was an excellent dive master, he had prepared all our gear, foresaw snacks and gave a very nice briefing.
